user.title: Name your controller
user.description: Choose a distinct name for this controller.

proof.title: Original caller proof
proof.description: Configure the milestone-one deterministic sequence. Permission starts disabled. Leave the activation entity empty for manual control. Each activation gradually brings the selected light to the configured brightness, then runs the light pair and optional remote activity.

yaml.title: Import Occupied YAML
yaml.description: Import a snapshot of your Occupied program. The source file is not watched or modified.

file.title: Use a managed file
file.description: Choose YAML under the Home Assistant config directory. The file remains authoritative and read only; changes are detected automatically.

error.name_already_exists: Another Occupied controller already uses this name. Choose a different name.
error.invalid_config: Check the selected entities, allowed states, activity name, and duration bounds.
error.invalid_program: The YAML is not a valid Occupied program. Validate it with the Occupied CLI to see field and line details.
error.invalid_file: Cannot load this file. Check the relative path, read permissions, and Occupied YAML; use the CLI for detailed validation.

abort.already_configured: This Occupied controller is already configured.
abort.invalid_program: The canonical Occupied program is invalid.
abort.ambiguous_instance: Use named controllers in configuration.yaml to identify the controller.

managed_file.title: Occupied managed configuration could not be loaded

source_conflict.title: Occupied bootstrap conflicts with {name}
source_conflict.description: configuration.yaml selects a different source for {name}. Select this controller in Occupied and change its source explicitly, or remove its bootstrap declaration. The existing source has been retained.

ambiguous_bootstrap.title: Occupied bootstrap needs a controller identity
ambiguous_bootstrap.description: Several Occupied controllers exist, so the legacy config_file declaration cannot identify the intended controller. Configure named entries under instances in configuration.yaml, with a stable id for each controller. Existing controllers have been retained.

invalid_program.title: Occupied stored program could not be loaded

start.name: Start managing
start.description: Allow this controller to manage its entities when activation conditions are met.

stop.name: Stop managing
stop.description: Stop managing entities, cancel lighting convergence, and apply configured owned activity cleanup.

pause.name: Pause management
pause.description: Pause entity management while keeping the controller enabled.

resume.name: Resume management
resume.description: Resume entity management when activation conditions are met.

reload.name: Reload managed file
reload.description: Validate and atomically reload the selected managed file. Invalid updates retain the last valid program.

entry_not_loaded.message: Occupied config entry is not loaded

select_managed_file.message: Select a managed file before reloading

managed_validation_failed.message: Managed file validation failed; see Occupied Configuration and Repairs

valid_file_required.message: Load a valid file before copying its program to GUI storage

daily_program_required.message: Apply the daily starter program before selecting a managed file

managed_file_authoritative.message: The managed file is authoritative. Export your draft or explicitly switch to GUI storage.

saved_program_unavailable.message: Could not load the saved daily program

journal_limit.message: Execution journal exceeds its bounded runtime limit

enforce_controller_changed.message: Cannot enforce expected states: controller changed

unloaded_before_save.message: Occupied is unloaded; refresh before saving
